records.recovery: Repeat only the fetch with explicit braced branch interpolation and keep the already successful push, tracking update, live-remote probe, and clean-state evidence.
records.passing_witness: The isolated literal refspec fetch succeeded and local, upstream, tracking, and fresh live remote all remained the exact x1 head with 0/0 divergence and clean state.
records.recurrence_guard: Use braced PowerShell variables whenever a branch variable is immediately followed by a colon.

records.sibling_recommendation: Separate push, fetch, and live-remote probes and brace refspec variables before a colon.
